lines: Phase 3 (the look lock) is 2 hours 53 minutes into its 11 hour box. The builders are 93 minutes into their 3 hours
Merged into main and pushed (dc24715): the light engine and the tree and winter's base. Parts light-engine and base-winter are built in the register. 330 of 330 tests green

The shake's real path is done on its branch: 4.56 percent of the frame kept above the glass on the worst frame of 19 paths (rule 4.5) and the foot's rim 1.06 mm clear of the slab (rule 1). It is merged together with the liquid's answer to two simulation tests
First reports are in from light and tree and base and shake and village. Each lists what is still wrong and keeps raising its part until about 13:00 UTC

Passed between builders: the veil must vanish at rest (it made the grey wash in the glass) and settled flakes take the light engine's shade and the close camera's focus goes on the door and the contact shadow and mirror image must follow the lifted globe
The published app is unchanged since 08:34 UTC. It is published again as soon as the real shake is on main so it can be shaken
phase 3: 3.08 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 9.69 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Shake builder: the real test shake from the fixed hero camera in 12 frames (the landing is at frame 144). The path is real: unequal strokes with sharp reversals and a lift of 7.25 mm. Still wrong and owned by others: the stand-in veil whites the glass out and the contact shadow stays behind as a hard hole
Shake builder: the path's curves over the bar. Six strokes of 15.6 to 22.4 mm that speed up; reversals of about 2 g; the rim of the foot kept 1 mm above the slab; the tilt capped at 6 degrees

Village builder: the approved image above and the first real cottage below (stone walls and snow roof and brick chimney and string lights and the wreath on the arched door and the fence and lamppost and pond ice). Still wrong: out of focus at this camera and the stones too rounded and lain flakes bury the path

Flake builder: the approved storm on the left and the build's storm on the right half a second after a landing (streaks along arcs; the miniature here is still a stand-in). Still wrong: flakes too large and too alike and the veil too even and too white
